Role Title: Mechanical Engineering Technician

Role Type: Contractor

Location: Remote

micro1 is engaging Mechanical Engineering Technicians to contribute to a customer's project involving the development of advanced AI benchmarks. In this role, you'll apply your expertise to help train next-generation AI systems. Your work will shape how models learn, reason, and perform through high-quality, real-world input. No prior experience in AI is required — your domain knowledge is what matters.

Scope of Work

  1. Design and author authentic technician workflow tasks that reflect real-world challenges, including test setup, instrumentation, data collection, and failure diagnosis.
  2. Source, synthesize, and construct technical datasets (such as test logs, calibration records, sensor outputs, and failure reports) derived from actual lab or production scenarios.
  3. Define accurate solution pathways, including the interpretation of test data and informed next-step recommendations.
  4. Develop rigorous, 35+ item grading rubrics to evaluate technical skills in instrumentation logic, data interpretation, and failure analysis, usable by AI and domain experts alike.
  5. Document detailed technical procedures, observations, and diagnostic findings with high precision and clarity.
  6. Ensure all evaluation tasks meet the complexity and realism standards representative of professional practice, surpassing simplified textbook examples.

Preferred Qualifications

  1. Minimum 4 years of hands-on experience in lab, test, or production environments within mechanical engineering technology.
  2. Associate degree or recognized trade credential in mechanical engineering technology or related discipline.
  3. Extensive experience with instrumentation, sensors, data acquisition systems, and prototype testing workflows.
  4. Demonstrated ability to perform in-depth technical documentation of test procedures, outcomes, and failure modes.
  5. Strong analytical skills for interpreting complex datasets and diagnosing equipment or process failures.
  6. Familiarity with technical documentation formats, such as CSVs, spreadsheets, PDFs, and other relevant files.
  7. Comfort working independently, contributing to remote projects, and aligning deliverables with high technical standards.

Compensation Structure

Compensation is output-based; experts are paid per task that meets the project specifications. The time required to complete work may vary depending on the expert’s experience and workflow. Minimum submission requirements apply. Experts must submit a minimum of tasks per week.

Start Timeline & Availability

We typically fill roles within 48 hours and are looking for experts ready to jump in right away. If selected, we expect you to start your first tasks within 24–48 hours of completing onboarding.

raw.title: Pricing Manager
raw.excerpt: GHX is seeking a strategic, systems-oriented Product Commercialization Manager to own and elevate the end-to-end commercialization process across our portfolio, including pricing, SKUs, process and tool management.
raw.description:
GHX is seeking a strategic, systems-oriented Product Commercialization Manager to own and elevate the end-to-end commercialization process across our portfolio, including pricing, SKUs, process and tool management. The role serves as the connective tissue between commercial strategy and operational execution — driving efficiency, scalability, and data integrity across the entire product commercialization lifecycle.

The right candidate brings both operational rigor and transformational vision — someone who can rationalize a complex SKU library, redesign product commercialization operating system using AI-powered automation, and build governance frameworks that enable faster, more precise market entry.Someone who is enthusiastic about managing projects but also willing to roll up their sleeves and do the work. A personable, determined individual who enjoys leading and facilitating cross-functional collaborations will thrive in this role.

Responsibilities:

Commercialization Process Ownership

  • Own the end-to-end commercialization process — from product definition through SKU creation to Launch— in partnership with Product Management, Corporate Systems, Deals Desk, Contract Ops, Order Processing, Revenue Recognition, and Asset Management.
  • Establish and continuously improve SOPs, tooling configurations, and business rules that reduce cycle time, eliminate ambiguity, and scale across GHX's expanding portfolio; maintain the commercialization playbook as the single source of truth for pricing, SKUs, and business rules.
  • Partner with Product Management to translate new offerings into sellable, billable constructs aligned to commercial strategy; serve as cross-functional liaison for complex SKUs and pricing decisions requiring commercial judgment.
  • Define, monitor, and report on SLAs, KPIs, and quality metrics for commercialization activities, delivering executive-ready insights on a regular cadence.
  • Stay current on AI and ML capabilities in CPQ; proactively surface forward-looking recommendations to leadership and cross-functional partners.

SKU Management & Catalog Governance

  • Own the full SKU lifecycle in CPQ (currently Conga) — including creation, testing, release, modification, and deprecation.
  • Lead a structured cross-functional SKU audit; rationalize the catalog and present findings and recommendations to leadership; establish ongoing governance including intake/approval workflows, naming conventions, taxonomy standards, and hygiene reviews.
  • Partner with Product, Finance, and Sales to ensure every SKU maps to a clear commercial purpose, pricing strategy, contractual language, and business rules; develop a change management process that minimizes disruption to active quotes, in-flight contracts, and renewal cycles.
  • Own the AI and automation innovation roadmap for SKU and commercialization processes — identifying high-value opportunities and driving measurable reduction in manual processing time.

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Strategy

  • Serve as the connective tissue between Product Management and all partner functions, including Sales, Revenue Operations, Deal Desk, Contract Operations, FP&A, Corporate Systems, and Revenue Enablement — aligning teams on process, tooling, and commercialization standards.
  • Contribute to pricing strategy and monetization model design; champion data-driven decision-making through dashboards and reporting frameworks that give leadership visibility into commercialization health.
  • Coordinate launch readiness for new products and pricing changes, ensuring Sales, Deal Desk, and Contract Operations are prepared before market release; act as a trusted advisor and go-to resource for commercialization process questions.

Key Competencies:

  • Translates business objectives into commercialization strategies; anticipates downstream impacts of process, pricing, and catalog decisions on revenue recognition, margin, and customer lifetime value.
  • Understands SaaS business models, subscription economics, and ARR/MRR dynamics; connects P&L awareness and process efficiency to growth acceleration.
  • Designs scalable, end-to-end commercialization processes with an automation-first, exception-second bias — comfortable operating from architecture-level design down to hands-on configuration and SOP documentation.
  • Uses quantitative analysis and operational data to identify problems, size opportunities, and evaluate trade-offs; designs reporting frameworks and dashboards that give leadership actionable visibility into commercialization health.
  • Sets clear goals, tracks progress rigorously, and communicates status proactively to executive, commercial, and technical audiences alike.
  • Builds trust across Product, Sales, Finance, Legal, and Technology without direct authority; navigates competing priorities with diplomacy and persistence.
  • Anticipates resistance to change and designs enablement strategies that drive adoption; delivers results with speed and quality in ambiguous, fast-moving environments.
  • Actively explores and applies AI and automation to commercialization challenges; evaluates tools critically with attention to limitations, compliance implications, and auditability.

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in business, Finance, Operations, Information Systems, or a related field; or equivalent professional experience.
  • 5+ years of progressive experience in product operations, revenue operations, deal desk, commercial program management, or a closely related function within a B2B SaaS company.
  • Demonstrated hands-on experience with Salesforce Conga (Apttus) — including product catalog management, pricing rules, approval workflows, and SKU configuration.
  • Proven track record leading cross-functional process improvement or transformation initiatives with measurable business outcomes (e.g., cycle time reduction, error rate improvement, revenue acceleration)
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to produce executive-ready documentation, SOPs, and business cases.

  • Project management discipline: ability to manage multiple concurrent workstreams, prioritize effectively under pressure, and deliver against commitments.

  • Willingness to travel quarterly for team meetings (approximately 10-20%).

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Familiarity with AI and automation concepts as they apply to commercial operations, quoting, or contract workflows.
  • Experience conducting SKU, product catalog, or similar rationalization audits in complex, multi-product environments.
  • Prior involvement in a quote-to-cash re-platforming or major system migration.
  • Proficiency with BI and analytics tools such as Sigma or Power BI for building commercialization performance dashboards.
  • Any of the following certifications:
    • Salesforce Certified CPQ Specialist or Salesforce Certified Administrator
    • Conga CPQ Product Administration Certification (Level 1 or Level 2)
    • PMP, Agile/Scrum, or SAFe® Product Owner / Product Manager certification

Estimated salary range: $91,000 - $121,000

The base salary range represents the anticipated low and high end of the GHX’s salary range for this position. Actual salaries will vary and will be based on various factors, such as candidate’s qualifications, skills, competencies and proficiency for the role. The base salary is one component of GHX’s total compensation package for employees. Other rewards and benefits include: health, vision, and dental insurance, accident and life insurance, 401k matching, paid-time off, and education reimbursement, to name a few. To view more details of our benefits, visit us here:

GHX: It's the way you do business in healthcare
Global Healthcare Exchange (GHX) enables better patient care and billions in savings for the healthcare community by maximizing automation, efficiency and accuracy of business processes.

GHX is a healthcare business and data automation company, empowering healthcare organizations to enable better patient care and maximize industry savings using our world class cloud-based supply chain technology exchange platform, solutions, analytics and services. We bring together healthcare providers and manufacturers and distributors in North America and Europe - who rely on smart, secure healthcare-focused technology and comprehensive data to automate their business processes and make more informed decisions.

It is our passion and vision for a more operationally efficient healthcare supply chain, helping organizations reduce - not shift - the cost of doing business, paving the way to delivering patient care more effectively. Together we take more than a billion dollars out of the cost of delivering healthcare every year. GHX is privately owned, operates in the United States, Canada and Europe, and employs more than 1000 people worldwide. Our corporate headquarters is in Colorado, with additional offices in Europe.

About this position:

We're looking for a Paid Social Media Specialist to drive measurable impact for Later Influence customers through high performance paid social campaigns. You'll manage campaigns end to end, planning, launching, optimizing, and reporting across key social platforms, to ensure they deliver against client objectives and business KPIs. This role sits within Later's Professional Services team and reports directly to the Director of Services, with close day to day collaboration across Account Managers, Coordinators, and creative teams. We're looking for someone with deep paid social expertise, direct agency or client services experience, and a strong ability to collaborate cross-functionally.

What you'll be doing:

Technical / Execution

  • Plan, launch, and manage paid social influencer and brand campaigns across Meta, TikTok, LinkedIn, YouTube, Snapchat, and emerging social platforms.
  • Own campaign QA, tracking setup (UTMs, pixels, conversion events), and media delivery standards.
  • Monitor performance and pacing continuously, making proactive adjustments to hit KPIs.
  • Translate campaign data into actionable insights and optimizations that improve efficiency and outcomes.
  • Build, deliver, and present reports (weekly, monthly, quarterly) that combine analysis with clear strategic recommendations.

Team / Collaboration

  • Partner closely with Account Managers and Coordinators to align on messaging, creative, CTAs, and campaign objectives.
  • Provide proactive guidance on paid content best practices and help educate internal teams on what drives performance.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with creative, analytics, and client success teams to ensure campaigns meet client expectations and business goals.

Research / Best Practices

  • Stay sharp on evolving platform algorithms, bidding strategies, and performance content trends.
  • Experiment with new ad formats, targeting tactics, and creator led paid media approaches.
  • Share learnings with the wider team to uplevel collective expertise and campaign outcomes.

What success looks like:

  • Campaigns consistently deliver against client KPIs (CTR, CPA, ROAS, engagement rates, or brand lift, depending on objectives).
  • Data and insights are presented clearly, driving strategic decisions and client trust.
  • You anticipate risks and opportunities, proactively adjusting tactics to ensure campaign success.
  • Internal stakeholders see you as a trusted expert in paid social, someone who raises the bar for execution and client results.
  • You bring resourcefulness to ambiguity, thrive on data driven problem solving, and collaborate to deliver measurable business impact for clients.

What you bring:

We are committed to building an inclusive, supportive place for you to do the best and most rewarding work of your career. If you identify with any of the following, we encourage you to apply!

  • Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
  • 2-3+ years of hands-on experience managing paid media campaigns, with a focus on social platforms.
  • Proven track record of hitting and exceeding performance goals in a paid social role, ideally within an agency or fast paced client services environment.
  • Strong analytical mindset, with a solid grasp of campaign performance metrics and reporting tools (Meta/TikTok/Google Ads reporting, Google Analytics, Tableau, Looker Studio, etc.) and the ability to turn data into clear, actionable recommendations.
  • Expertise with campaign management platforms (Meta Ads Manager, TikTok Ads Manager, LinkedIn Campaign Manager, Pinterest Ads, etc.).
  • Meticulous attention to detail, especially in trafficking, QA, and live asset management.
  • A keen eye for paid social creative and knowledge of current performance content best practices.
  • Nice to have: experience with creator led paid content.

How you work:

  • **How we work:**
  • We will do whatever it takes to win: We win when our customers and creators win. We bring full commitment to outcomes that matter, not just effort.
  • We have no limit to our aspiration: We think big, push beyond what seems possible, and refuse to let conventional thinking set the ceiling.
  • We are relentless: We keep going. Through ambiguity, setbacks, and competing priorities, we find a way forward.
  • We deeply understand our business: If we don't have the knowledge, we figure it out. We take ownership of understanding how Later works and what drives results.
  • We take our work seriously, but not ourselves: We bring rigor and accountability without ego, and we make space for each other to do our best work.

Our approach to compensation:

We take a market-based & data-driven approach to compensation. We leverage data from trusted third-party compensation sources to help us understand the market value of a role based on function, level, geographic location, and scope. We evaluate compensation bi-annually, including performance and market-related factors.

Our salaries are benchmarked against market Total Cash Compensation for the geographic location of our job posting. Compensation for some roles is structured as On Target Earnings (OTE = base + commission/variable) while for others it is structured as Salary only.

To comply with local legislation and ensure transparency, we share salary ranges on all job postings. Skills, experience and other factors help determine the final salary we offer which may vary from the original range posted.

Additionally, all permanent team members are eligible to participate in various benefits plans as part of their overall compensation package.

Job Title: Cyber Security Analyst (GRC)

Location: 100% Remote (EST/CST/MST)

Company Overview:
Glint Tech Solutions is a women-owned, global IT staffing and recruiting firm serving enterprise clients across the USA and Canada. We are currently hiring on behalf of a leading healthcare insurance client.

Project Description:
Our client is seeking a Cyber Security Risk Analyst to ensure organizational data remains protected from inappropriate access, disclosure, and damage by assessing, documenting, and socializing risk. This role reports to the Manager, Cybersecurity Risk and Compliance.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Support the Cybersecurity Risk Management program, guiding a diverse technical team and collaborating across risk-related teams
  • Partner with TPRM, Procurement, Legal, and business stakeholders on continuous monitoring efforts
  • Assess cybersecurity controls, identify gaps, and manage mitigation strategies to closure
  • Conduct risk assessments evaluating security practices, data handling procedures, and regulatory compliance (HIPAA, PCI, GDPR)
  • Prepare detailed risk assessment reports and maintain a comprehensive repository of documentation
  • Design, implement, and integrate security solutions to address enterprise risks
  • Develop Information Security Risk Metrics (KPIs/KRIs) to support the analytics team
  • Support NIST, FedRAMP, and HIPAA compliance efforts including assessment readiness, POA&M management, and continuous monitoring

Mandatory Skills:

  • One or more certifications: CISSP, CEH, CTIA, CAP, or EnCase Certified Examiner
  • Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Cyber Security, IT, or related field (or 4 additional years of experience in lieu of degree)
  • 5+ years of cybersecurity experience, specifically in Risk Management, with 3rd party/supplier risk assessment knowledge
  • Experience with eGRC platforms (HyperProof, Archer, or ServiceNow GRC)
  • Strong understanding of NIST Risk Management Framework and FAIR quantitative model
  • Ability to develop and socialize security policies, standards, and procedures
  • Knowledge of HIPAA/PHI security standards and network/firewall architecture

Nice-to-Have Skills:

  • SOC Reporting / HITRUST knowledge
  • Diverse background in cloud (off-prem) platforms
  • Experience within the healthcare insurance/payor industry

Role Overview

Reporting directly to the Manager, Government Pricing, the Government Pricing Analyst role involves reviewing, validating, and reconciling client transactions for government pricing calculations while analyzing variances for Federal Drug Programs such as Average Manufacturer Price “AMP”, Best Price “BP”, Unit Rebate Amount “URA”, Public Health Services “PHS”, Average Sales Price “ASP”, Non-Federal Average Manufacturer Price “NFAMP”, Federal Ceiling Price “FCP”, and Industrial Funding Fee “IFF”. Responsibilities include documenting variance analyses, generating customer reporting packages, ensuring timely submission of government price reports, and processing of Tricare rebates. The position also entails coordinating with the government pricing team on deliverable checklists, support with continuous improvement projects and aids on ad hoc projects as needed.

Key Responsibilities

  • Review, validate, and reconcile client transactions for government pricing calculations
  • Calculate and analyze government pricing variances for the Federal Drug Programs including AMP, BP, URA, PHS, ASP, NFAMP, FCP, and IFF
  • Document calculation variance analysis and generate client reporting packages
  • Ensure the timely submission of government price reporting
  • Process, analyze, and prepare client reporting requirements
  • Processes Tricare rebates
  • Work with the government pricing team to coordinate client deliverable checklist completion
  • Participate in continuous improvement projects
  • Support the Manager, Government Pricing and Medispend team with ad hoc projects

Qualifications

  • 1 – 2 years of experience with data analysis preferred government pricing; bachelor’s or associate degree if less than 1 year of experience
  • Working knowledge of pharmaceutical government pricing calculations and financial software systems
  • Problem solving skills and the ability to analyze complex calculations
  • Strong business analysis and organizational skills
  • Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written
  • Ability to create, interpret, and communicate detailed report data
  • Advanced skills in Excel and Word
  • Ability to work both independently and as a team

What we provide:

  • Merit-based compensation – Competitive base salary plus bonus
  • Work from anywhere – Roles are open to candidates located anywhere in the US (United States)
  • Unlimited PTO (Paid Time Off), including Paid Holidays and Sick Leave
  • 401k+ Match
  • Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance
  • Paid Parental Leave
  • Health and wellness perks including life & disability insurance, healthcare funding options like FSAs (Flexible Spending Accounts) and HSAs (Health Savings Account), Dependent Care, an EAP (Employee Assistance Program) program, discounts, Learning and Development

Working Conditions/Physical Demands:

This position is fully remote, with limited travel that may be required for occasional team meetings, training sessions, or business events. Work is performed primarily in a home-office environment using standard office equipment such as a computer, keyboard, mouse, and phone. Employees are expected to maintain a safe, ergonomic, and confidential workspace with reliable high-speed internet access suitable for professional remote work.

The role generally requires extended periods of sitting, viewing a computer screen, and communicating through written and verbal means. Occasional light physical activity (e.g., lifting materials or equipment up to 20 pounds) may be necessary.

Reasonable accommodations will be provided in accordance with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) and other applicable laws to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the job. Employees working remotely must ensure their workspace meets company standards for safety, ergonomics, and data security as outlined in organizational policy.

Disclaimer: This job description identifies the general duties and minimum level of skills required to perform this job. It is not intended to represent a comprehensive inventory of all duties, responsibilities and qualifications required of employees assigned.

Notice for all applicants: we are seeking a permanent full-time employee, this is not a contractor position.

Notice for Colorado and Washington applicants: In compliance with applicable pay transparency laws, the expected annual base salary for this role is $50,000–$70,000, plus eligibility for bonus and benefits.

Medispend is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and is committed to maintaining a diverse and inclusive work environment. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, physical or mental disability, age, or veteran status or any other basis protected by federal, state, or local law.

To all recruitment agencies: We do not accept unsolicited agency resumes and are not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

Their BIM & Digital (BIM&D) function develops digital construction and engineering solutions that enable GES stakeholders to improve quality, compliance, sustainability, risk management, scheduling, and virtual design review.

They are seeking a hands-on, technically strong Software Developer to build, integrate, and enhance software products across Amazon PreConnector, AWS, Autodesk platforms, and AI-enabled engineering workflows.

Job Title

Software Developer

Job Summary

Our client is seeking a hands-on Software Developer to join the BIM&D technology team and contribute to the development and enhancement of innovative software products. The core focus of this role is full-stack software development, API integration, cloud technologies, and AI-assisted engineering.

The successful candidate will design, develop, test, and maintain scalable web applications and APIs within a microservices architecture. They will work extensively with Amazon PreConnector, integrating AWS and Autodesk Platform Services, developing MCP-based integrations, and leveraging AI-assisted development tools such as Claude Code and Amazon Q Developer to accelerate delivery and improve engineering productivity.

The role requires strong experience with React.js, JavaScript/TypeScript, Java Spring Framework, AWS, RESTful APIs, microservices, and Git-based development workflows. Experience with Python, SQL, dbt, or AI/ML integration patterns is also valuable.

BIM and digital construction knowledge is beneficial but not a prerequisite, as the team will provide the necessary domain context and training.

The ideal candidate is a proactive software engineer who enjoys solving complex technical problems, working with emerging technologies, collaborating with cross-functional teams, and building reliable, scalable solutions in a fast-paced environment.

Key Responsibilities

Software Development & Architecture

  • Design, develop, and maintain scalable web applications and APIs using a microservices architecture.
  • Build high-performance, reliable features for Amazon PreConnector and related BIM&D software products.
  • Contribute to software architecture decisions and ensure solutions are scalable, maintainable, and secure.
  • Troubleshoot technical issues and conduct structured root-cause analysis.

AI-Assisted Development

  • Leverage AI coding tools such as Claude Code and Amazon Q Developer to accelerate feature development.
  • Use AI-assisted tooling to automate repetitive engineering tasks and improve development productivity.
  • Explore and apply emerging AI development practices to improve code quality and delivery efficiency.

MCP & AI Agent Integration

  • Work with Model Context Protocol (MCP) integrations within Amazon PreConnector.
  • Enable AI agents to interact with AWS data services and internal business intelligence systems.
  • Support the development and integration of MCP-based solutions for external APIs and enterprise data systems.
  • Contribute to agentic AI workflows and AI/ML integration patterns where applicable.

AWS & Amazon Platform Integration

  • Develop and maintain integrations with AWS services including EC2, Lambda, S3, API Gateway, and Amazon Redshift.
  • Work with AWS data lakes and Amazon internal data and reporting platforms.
  • Enable secure data exchange and data democratization across GES stakeholders.
  • Support real-time reporting and analytics capabilities across BIM&D products.

API Design & Development

  • Architect, build, test, and document secure RESTful APIs.
  • Integrate Autodesk Construction Cloud, Autodesk Platform Services, AWS services, and Amazon internal platforms.
  • Follow OpenAPI standards and applicable Amazon security and engineering policies.
  • Ensure APIs are scalable, reliable, secure, and maintainable.

User Interface & Experience

  • Develop intuitive and accessible front-end interfaces for BIM and digital construction applications using React.js.
  • Apply user-centred design principles to create effective user experiences.
  • Maintain consistency with established Amazon design systems and engineering standards.

Performance & Reliability

  • Identify performance bottlenecks across applications, APIs, and data pipelines.
  • Implement solutions to improve throughput, reduce latency, and enhance system reliability.
  • Monitor and continuously improve application performance at scale.

Testing & Quality Assurance

  • Develop and maintain unit, integration, and end-to-end automated tests.
  • Integrate automated testing into CI/CD pipelines.
  • Ensure software meets required reliability, security, quality, and compliance standards.
  • Participate in code reviews and contribute to continuous improvement of engineering practices.

Documentation & Knowledge Management

  • Produce and maintain clear technical documentation covering software, APIs, architecture, and integration patterns.
  • Document development standards and technical solutions to support knowledge sharing across the BIM&D team.
  • Contribute to effective technical knowledge transfer across engineering and business stakeholders.

Cross-functional Collaboration

  • Collaborate with BIM specialists, GES engineers, data scientists, product managers, and Amazon technology teams.
  • Translate business requirements into practical technical solutions.
  • Communicate complex technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Platform Maintenance & Continuous Improvement

  • Maintain and enhance existing Amazon PreConnector modules and ACC/BIM360 integrations.
  • Support technology solutions serving GES functions including Quality, Compliance, Sustainability, Risk Management, Scheduling, and Virtual Design Review.
  • Identify opportunities to improve existing processes, systems, integrations, and engineering workflows.

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree or higher in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related discipline.
  • 3–4 years of professional software development experience.
  • 2–3 years of hands-on experience with React.js, JavaScript (ES6+), and Java Spring Framework for full-stack web application development.
  • 1–2 years of practical experience designing and developing microservices-based architectures and distributed systems.
  • 1–2 years of experience with Amazon Web Services (AWS), including services such as EC2, Lambda, S3, API Gateway, and Amazon Redshift.
  • Experience or exposure to CI/CD pipelines using AWS CodePipeline, AWS CodeBuild, or equivalent tools.
  • 1+ year of experience with Git and collaborative development workflows, including pull requests, code reviews, and branching strategies.
  • Strong analytical, debugging, and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English, with the ability to explain technical concepts clearly to non-technical stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Familiarity with Autodesk Platform Services (APS) APIs, including Model Derivative, Data Management, Design Automation, and Viewer APIs.
  • Awareness of Autodesk Construction Cloud (ACC) and/or BIM360 platforms.
  • Understanding of BIM principles and industry standards such as ISO 19650.
  • Familiarity with BIM authoring tools such as Revit, AutoCAD, or Navisworks.
  • Experience building or consuming Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers.
  • Familiarity with agentic workflow design, prompt engineering, or AI/ML integration patterns.
  • Experience integrating with Amazon internal platforms, AWS data lakes, Redshift, BI, or reporting systems.
  • Experience with Python, TypeScript, C#/.NET, SQL, and dbt.
  • Experience working with data-intensive applications or construction technology platforms.

Software / Programs / Tools

  • Programming Languages: Python, JavaScript, TypeScript, Java, .NET/C#, SQL
  • Data & Analytics: dbt, Amazon Redshift, AWS data lakes
  • Frontend: React.js
  • Backend: Java Spring Framework, REST APIs, Microservices
  • Cloud: Amazon Web Services (AWS), including EC2, Lambda, S3, API Gateway, and Redshift
  • AI Development: Claude Code, Amazon Q Developer, AI/ML integration tools
  • AI Integration: Model Context Protocol (MCP), agentic workflows
  • DevOps: Git, CI/CD, AWS CodePipeline, AWS CodeBuild
  • Autodesk: Autodesk Platform Services (APS), Autodesk Construction Cloud (ACC), BIM360

Job Details

  • Employment Type: Full-time
  • Department: BIM & Digital (BIM&D)
  • Industry: E-commerce / Technology / Digital Construction
  • Experience Level: Mid-Level
  • Years of Experience: 3–4 years
  • Technical Assessment: Yes
  • Travel Required: No
  • Priority: High
  • Work Focus: Software Development, Cloud Integration, APIs, AI-Assisted Development, BIM Technology

Note: BIM domain expertise is preferred but not mandatory. The successful candidate will receive relevant domain context and support from the BIM&D team. The primary requirement is strong hands-on software development capability combined with the ability to learn and work across cloud, API, Autodesk, and AI-enabled technologies.

No prior experience in AI is required — your domain knowledge is what matters.

Scope of Work

  1. Clean, preprocess, and structure complex and messy datasets using advanced statistical software (such as R, Python, SAS, or Stata).

  7. Continuously identify data quality issues, provide actionable recommendations, and document solutions for handling dirty or incomplete data.

Preferred Qualifications

  1. Advanced degree (MS or PhD) in Statistics, Data Science, Mathematics, Biostatistics, or a related quantitative field.
  2. Expertise in cleaning and preparing complex, messy (“dirty”) datasets with R, Python, SAS, or Stata.
  3. Proficiency in basic descriptive and inferential statistical techniques, including hypothesis testing and regression analysis.
  4. Strong programming skills in Python or R for statistical analysis, data manipulation, and visualization.
  5. Demonstrated ability to communicate complex findings to non-technical and technical audiences with clarity and precision.
  6. Experience working with large, unstructured, or noisy datasets across a variety of domains.
  7. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with a focus on detailed documentation and collaboration in remote environments.

Promover y asegurar el cumplimiento de las políticas, procesos y procedimientos de Salud, Seguridad y Medio Ambiente (HSE), así como de los modelos de gestión implementados por la compañía, garantizando el cumplimiento de los requisitos legales, contractuales y de las Órdenes de (ODS) bajo su responsabilidad.

En este puesto, sus responsabilidades serán:

1. Gestión Administrativa y de Sistema HSE

  • Ejecutar el Plan de Trabajo HSE del proyecto de las órdenes de servicio (ODS) asignadas.

  • Promover la correcta comprensión y aplicación de la Política de HSE en cada ODS.

  • Gestionar eficientemente los recursos definidos para la operación de HSE de la ODS.

  • Elaborar y entregar reportes diarios, mensuales, trimestrales, semestrales y anuales de gestión HSE de la ODS, según aplique.

  • Administrar, actualizar y dar seguimiento a la documentación, formatos y procedimientos requeridos para la implementación y mantenimiento del Sistema de Gestión HSE.

  • Elaborar y mantener actualizado el Dossier de HSE de la ODS.

  • Distribuir material de seguridad operativo y administrativo a los ODS vigentes.

  • Gestionar y apoyar la tramitación de permisos de trabajo cuando las condiciones de la ODS lo requieran, de acuerdo con la metodología del cliente.

  • Tramitar solicitudes del personal relacionadas con aspectos HSE.

  • Proponer oportunidades de mejora continua al Sistema de Gestión HSE.

2. Seguridad, Salud en el Trabajo y Medio Ambiente (HSE)

  • Liderar y participar activamente en la identificación de peligros, evaluación y control de riesgos, así como en la identificación de aspectos e impactos ambientales significativos de las ODS.

  • Asegurar la implementación de medidas de control para minimizar riesgos ocupacionales e impactos ambientales, conforme a las metodologías y procedimientos establecidos.

  • Realizar inspecciones periódicas en materia de seguridad, salud en el trabajo y medio ambiente, y participar en auditorías internas y externas del sistema HSE.

  • Controlar y apoyar la correcta gestión de residuos generados en las operaciones del proyecto.

  • Exigir y verificar el cumplimiento de condiciones seguras de trabajo para la protección de la salud de los trabajadores, y el cuidado del medio ambiente y los activos del cliente.

  • Detener o restringir actividades que no cumplan con las condiciones mínimas de seguridad o que representen riesgos significativos para las personas o el medio ambiente.

  • Aplicar y asegurar la correcta ejecución del Plan de Respuesta a Emergencias de la ODS.

3. Cumplimiento Legal y Reporte

  • Reportar oportunamente al supervisor, o supervisores inmediatos, cualquier desviación, condición insegura o situación que pueda afectar la salud, la seguridad o el medio ambiente.

  • Reportar los accidentes de trabajo al supervisor, o supervisores inmediatos, en apego al proceso definido por cliente, y participar en las investigaciones de accidentes, incidentes y enfermedades laborales.

  • Promover activamente la cultura de reporte de actos y condiciones inseguras entre el personal del proyecto.

  • Recopilar, consolidar y mantener disponible la información de seguridad del proyecto para requerimientos de la alta gerencia y entes de control.

4. Formación y Cultura HSE

  • Solicitar y ejecutar los entrenamientos y capacitaciones HSE programados en la ODS.

  • Implementar espacios formativos y de refuerzo en temas de HSE dirigidos al personal.

  • Participar activamente en las reuniones del Comité de Seguridad y Salud en el Trabajo y en reuniones periódicas de HSE.

  • Fomentar el autocuidado, la conducta preventiva y una actitud proactiva frente a los riesgos laborales y ambientales.

Autoridad y Rendición de Cuentas

  • Responsabilidad sobre la correcta implementación y seguimiento del Sistema de Gestión HSE del proyecto.

  • Entrega de reportes HSE conforme a la periodicidad definida y a los lineamientos establecidos en revisiones y reuniones gerenciales.

Quién es usted:

Tú eres una persona con una fuerte orientación a la colaboración, que trabaja de manera efectiva con otros para alcanzar objetivos comunes, promoviendo relaciones de confianza y un ambiente de cooperación. Actúas con responsabilidad y apego a los estándares, asegurando el cumplimiento de compromisos y fomentando la rendición de cuentas. Generas confianza a través de una conducta consistente, ética y comprometida, planificando y organizando tu trabajo con claridad para alinear esfuerzos y prioridades. Además, proporcionas retroalimentación constructiva que impulsa el desarrollo de las personas, manteniendo disciplina y enfoque en la ejecución, lo que te permite cumplir objetivos y entregar resultados de manera sostenida

Para este puesto, necesitará:

Educación

  • Profesional universitario, Titulado en Ingeniería o Licenciatura.
  • Se aceptan otras carreras universitarias siempre que cumplan con la especialización y licencia requeridas.
  • Especialización en Seguridad y Salud en el Trabajo o Riesgos Laborales, con Licencia en Seguridad y Salud en el Trabajo (LSST) vigente.

  • Disponibilidad para viajar

Formación y Entrenamiento

  • Curso de coordinador de trabajo en altura
  • Inducción en los lineamientos del Sistema de Gestión Integral HSE.
  • Capacitación en la Matriz de Entrenamiento HSE.
  • Experiencia de trabajo en materia de Seguridad, Salud en el Trabajo y Medio Ambiente (HSE) en Ecopetrol.

Experiencia

  • Experiencia específica en el cargo: mínimo 3 años.
  • Experiencia profesional en gestión ambiental: mínimo 1 año.

Calificaciones preferidas que lo diferenciarán:

Organizacionales:

  • Trabajo en equipo

  • Alto sentido de responsabilidad y compromiso laboral

Del Cargo:

En Emerson, priorizamos un entorno de trabajo donde cada empleado sea valorado, respetado y tenga la oportunidad de desarrollarse profesionalmente. Fomentamos un ambiente que impulsa la innovación, la colaboración y la diversidad de perspectivas, porque sabemos que las grandes ideas surgen de grandes equipos. Nuestro compromiso con el desarrollo continuo de carrera y con el fortalecimiento de una cultura inclusiva garantiza que usted cuente con el apoyo necesario para prosperar. Creemos que los equipos diversos que trabajan juntos son clave para impulsar el crecimiento y alcanzar resultados de negocio.

Reconocemos la importancia del bienestar de nuestros empleados. Por ello, ofrecemos competitivos planes de beneficios, diversas opciones de seguros médicos, un Programa de Asistencia al Empleado (EAP), grupos de recursos para empleados, programas de reconocimiento y mucho más. About Ethos

Ethos is a leading life insurance technology company on a mission to protect families by democratizing access to life insurance and empowering agents at scale. With its robust three-sided technology platform, Ethos is transforming the life insurance experience for consumers, agents, and carriers alike. Ethos offers instant, accessible products and a seamless online process that requires no medical exams and just a few health questions; it eliminates traditional barriers, making it easier than ever for everyone to protect their families. Ethos is redefining how life insurance is bought, sold, and underwritten.

About the role

Creating a world-class customer experience is critical to Ethos' mission and will continue to determine our growth and success at the intersection of life insurance and technology. We're looking for a leader who can build the CX processes, tools, and voice-of-customer channels we need to move from reactive problem-solving to a proactive customer experience engine: one that consistently identifies where we're falling short and drives improvements forward, end to end. To succeed in this role, you should be passionate about building frictionless operations and comfortable owning ambiguity as we mature this function.

Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Own and execute on a prioritized CX roadmap spanning process, technology, product, and marketing driven improvements - driving cross-functional execution and ensuring priorities translate into delivered outcomes.

Motive empowers the people who run physical operations with tools to make their work safer, more productive, and more profitable. Motive serves nearly 100,000 customers – from Fortune 500 enterprises to small businesses – across a wide range of industries, including transportation and logistics, construction, energy, field service, manufacturing, agriculture, food and beverage, retail, and the public sector.

Visit to learn more.

About the Role:

Motive’s Enablement team plays a critical role in establishing strategic governance for AI tooling and implementing new solutions, ensuring our field teams are equipped with the best tools, workflows, and resources they need to win. We are seeking a results-oriented AI Enablement Specialist to govern, design, and optimize Outreach and other AI-powered sales technology in order to maximize efficiency and effectiveness of our Sales organization.

This is an individual contributor role focused on two connected priorities: Outreach administration and AI tooling strategy. The ideal candidate will establish the operating model for Outreach, build and implement sales sequences directly in Outreach, and partner cross-functionally to scope, launch, and measure AI solutions across tools such as Glean, Full Stack, Google AI Studio, and other emerging technologies. Success in this role is measured by field adoption of central AI solutions, improvements to field efficiency and effectiveness as a result of using these solutions, and influenced Revenue outcomes such as increased pipeline generation.

What You'll Do:

  • Outreach Governance & Strategy: Develop and own the governance model for Outreach content, sequences, and AI-enabled workflows to ensure quality, consistency, and alignment to business goals
  • Sequence Development & Optimization: Build, launch, maintain, and continuously improve sequences based on business priorities and performance data.
  • Experimentation & Performance Analysis: Partner with Marketing to run A/B tests across messaging, personas, and sequencing approaches; analyze performance trends and translate findings into improvements.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Establish and lead an Outreach steering committee, partnering with Sales Leadership, Marketing, Sales Transformation, and other key stakeholders to drive prioritization, performance standards, and sequence adoption.
  • AI Tooling & Enablement: Evaluate which AI agents and workflows can create the most value for the field, and partner with SOPs and AI Operations teams to scope, implement, and measure new solutions.
  • Change Management: Drive field adoption of new Outreach capabilities and AI solutions through clear enablement plans, stakeholder communication, training, and performance measurement.
  • Business Impact Measurement: Define success metrics for Outreach and AI tooling initiatives, monitor adoption and effectiveness, and connect improvements in prospecting effectiveness to pipeline and Revenue outcomes.

What We're Looking For:

  • AI native: experience developing AI governance, strategy, implementing AI tools and building AI solutions for a GTM organization.
  • Sales tool administration experiencewith an emphasis on modern, AI-integrated tools such as Outreach, Glean, Google AI Studio, Fullstack, N8N, and Salesforce.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Computer Science, or a related field
  • 4+ years of experience in sales enablement, revenue operations, or a related role within a high-growth B2B SaaS organization
  • Experience administering Outreach including creating sequences, maintaining sequence libraries, building views and dashboards, and analyzing usage and performance.
  • Fluent in change management methodologies, with demonstrated success driving tool and process adoption across large organizations
  • Strong analytical skills with experience designing experiments, interpreting performance data, and identifying repeatable improvements across personas, messaging, and process
  • Excellent communication and cross-functional influencing skills, with the ability to work effectively with global Sales Leadership, Marketing, Sales Transformation, and Operations stakeholders.
  • Bias for action and comfort operating in a fast-paced environment while managing multiple priorities.

Their BIM & Digital (BIM&D) function develops digital construction and engineering solutions that enable GES stakeholders to improve quality, compliance, sustainability, risk management, scheduling, and virtual design review.

They are seeking a hands-on, technically strong Software Developer to build, integrate, and enhance software products across Amazon PreConnector, AWS, Autodesk platforms, and AI-enabled engineering workflows.

Job Title

Software Developer

Job Summary

Our client is seeking a hands-on Software Developer to join the BIM&D technology team and contribute to the development and enhancement of innovative software products. The core focus of this role is full-stack software development, API integration, cloud technologies, and AI-assisted engineering.

The successful candidate will design, develop, test, and maintain scalable web applications and APIs within a microservices architecture. They will work extensively with Amazon PreConnector, integrating AWS and Autodesk Platform Services, developing MCP-based integrations, and leveraging AI-assisted development tools such as Claude Code and Amazon Q Developer to accelerate delivery and improve engineering productivity.

The role requires strong experience with React.js, JavaScript/TypeScript, Java Spring Framework, AWS, RESTful APIs, microservices, and Git-based development workflows. Experience with Python, SQL, dbt, or AI/ML integration patterns is also valuable.

BIM and digital construction knowledge is beneficial but not a prerequisite, as the team will provide the necessary domain context and training.

The ideal candidate is a proactive software engineer who enjoys solving complex technical problems, working with emerging technologies, collaborating with cross-functional teams, and building reliable, scalable solutions in a fast-paced environment.

Key Responsibilities

Software Development & Architecture

AI-Assisted Development

  • Leverage AI coding tools such as Claude Code and Amazon Q Developer to accelerate feature development.

MCP & AI Agent Integration

  • Work with Model Context Protocol (MCP) integrations within Amazon PreConnector.
  • Enable AI agents to interact with AWS data services and internal business intelligence systems.

  • Contribute to agentic AI workflows and AI/ML integration patterns where applicable.

AWS & Amazon Platform Integration

  • Develop and maintain integrations with AWS services including EC2, Lambda, S3, API Gateway, and Amazon Redshift.
  • Work with AWS data lakes and Amazon internal data and reporting platforms.
  • Enable secure data exchange and data democratization across GES stakeholders.
  • Support real-time reporting and analytics capabilities across BIM&D products.

API Design & Development

  • Architect, build, test, and document secure RESTful APIs.
  • Integrate Autodesk Construction Cloud, Autodesk Platform Services, AWS services, and Amazon internal platforms.
  • Follow OpenAPI standards and applicable Amazon security and engineering policies.
  • Ensure APIs are scalable, reliable, secure, and maintainable.

User Interface & Experience

  • Develop intuitive and accessible front-end interfaces for BIM and digital construction applications using React.js.
  • Apply user-centred design principles to create effective user experiences.
  • Maintain consistency with established Amazon design systems and engineering standards.

Performance & Reliability

  • Identify performance bottlenecks across applications, APIs, and data pipelines.
  • Implement solutions to improve throughput, reduce latency, and enhance system reliability.
  • Monitor and continuously improve application performance at scale.

Testing & Quality Assurance

  • Develop and maintain unit, integration, and end-to-end automated tests.
  • Integrate automated testing into CI/CD pipelines.
  • Ensure software meets required reliability, security, quality, and compliance standards.
  • Participate in code reviews and contribute to continuous improvement of engineering practices.

Documentation & Knowledge Management

  • Produce and maintain clear technical documentation covering software, APIs, architecture, and integration patterns.
  • Document development standards and technical solutions to support knowledge sharing across the BIM&D team.
  • Contribute to effective technical knowledge transfer across engineering and business stakeholders.

Cross-functional Collaboration

  • Collaborate with BIM specialists, GES engineers, data scientists, product managers, and Amazon technology teams.
  • Translate business requirements into practical technical solutions.
  • Communicate complex technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Platform Maintenance & Continuous Improvement

  • Maintain and enhance existing Amazon PreConnector modules and ACC/BIM360 integrations.
  • Support technology solutions serving GES functions including Quality, Compliance, Sustainability, Risk Management, Scheduling, and Virtual Design Review.
  • Identify opportunities to improve existing processes, systems, integrations, and engineering workflows.

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree or higher in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related discipline.
  • 3–4 years of professional software development experience.
  • 2–3 years of hands-on experience with React.js, JavaScript (ES6+), and Java Spring Framework for full-stack web application development.
  • 1–2 years of practical experience designing and developing microservices-based architectures and distributed systems.
  • 1–2 years of experience with Amazon Web Services (AWS), including services such as EC2, Lambda, S3, API Gateway, and Amazon Redshift.
  • Experience or exposure to CI/CD pipelines using AWS CodePipeline, AWS CodeBuild, or equivalent tools.
  • 1+ year of experience with Git and collaborative development workflows, including pull requests, code reviews, and branching strategies.
  • Strong analytical, debugging, and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English, with the ability to explain technical concepts clearly to non-technical stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Familiarity with Autodesk Platform Services (APS) APIs, including Model Derivative, Data Management, Design Automation, and Viewer APIs.
  • Awareness of Autodesk Construction Cloud (ACC) and/or BIM360 platforms.
  • Understanding of BIM principles and industry standards such as ISO 19650.
  • Familiarity with BIM authoring tools such as Revit, AutoCAD, or Navisworks.
  • Experience building or consuming Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers.
  • Familiarity with agentic workflow design, prompt engineering, or AI/ML integration patterns.
  • Experience integrating with Amazon internal platforms, AWS data lakes, Redshift, BI, or reporting systems.
  • Experience with Python, TypeScript, C#/.NET, SQL, and dbt.
  • Experience working with data-intensive applications or construction technology platforms.

Software / Programs / Tools

  • Programming Languages: Python, JavaScript, TypeScript, Java, .NET/C#, SQL
  • Data & Analytics: dbt, Amazon Redshift, AWS data lakes
  • Frontend: React.js
  • Backend: Java Spring Framework, REST APIs, Microservices
  • Cloud: Amazon Web Services (AWS), including EC2, Lambda, S3, API Gateway, and Redshift
  • AI Development: Claude Code, Amazon Q Developer, AI/ML integration tools
  • AI Integration: Model Context Protocol (MCP), agentic workflows
  • DevOps: Git, CI/CD, AWS CodePipeline, AWS CodeBuild
  • Autodesk: Autodesk Platform Services (APS), Autodesk Construction Cloud (ACC), BIM360

Job Details

En este puesto, sus responsabilidades serán:

1. Gestión Administrativa y de Sistema HSE

  • Ejecutar el Plan de Trabajo HSE del proyecto de las órdenes de servicio (ODS) asignadas.

  • Promover la correcta comprensión y aplicación de la Política de HSE en cada ODS.

  • Gestionar eficientemente los recursos definidos para la operación de HSE de la ODS.

  • Elaborar y entregar reportes diarios, mensuales, trimestrales, semestrales y anuales de gestión HSE de la ODS, según aplique.

  • Administrar, actualizar y dar seguimiento a la documentación, formatos y procedimientos requeridos para la implementación y mantenimiento del Sistema de Gestión HSE.

  • Elaborar y mantener actualizado el Dossier de HSE de la ODS.

  • Distribuir material de seguridad operativo y administrativo a los ODS vigentes.

  • Gestionar y apoyar la tramitación de permisos de trabajo cuando las condiciones de la ODS lo requieran, de acuerdo con la metodología del cliente.

  • Tramitar solicitudes del personal relacionadas con aspectos HSE.

  • Proponer oportunidades de mejora continua al Sistema de Gestión HSE.

2. Seguridad, Salud en el Trabajo y Medio Ambiente (HSE)

  • Liderar y participar activamente en la identificación de peligros, evaluación y control de riesgos, así como en la identificación de aspectos e impactos ambientales significativos de las ODS.

  • Asegurar la implementación de medidas de control para minimizar riesgos ocupacionales e impactos ambientales, conforme a las metodologías y procedimientos establecidos.

  • Realizar inspecciones periódicas en materia de seguridad, salud en el trabajo y medio ambiente, y participar en auditorías internas y externas del sistema HSE.

  • Controlar y apoyar la correcta gestión de residuos generados en las operaciones del proyecto.

  • Exigir y verificar el cumplimiento de condiciones seguras de trabajo para la protección de la salud de los trabajadores, y el cuidado del medio ambiente y los activos del cliente.

  • Detener o restringir actividades que no cumplan con las condiciones mínimas de seguridad o que representen riesgos significativos para las personas o el medio ambiente.

  • Aplicar y asegurar la correcta ejecución del Plan de Respuesta a Emergencias de la ODS.

3. Cumplimiento Legal y Reporte

  • Reportar oportunamente al supervisor, o supervisores inmediatos, cualquier desviación, condición insegura o situación que pueda afectar la salud, la seguridad o el medio ambiente.

  • Reportar los accidentes de trabajo al supervisor, o supervisores inmediatos, en apego al proceso definido por cliente, y participar en las investigaciones de accidentes, incidentes y enfermedades laborales.

  • Promover activamente la cultura de reporte de actos y condiciones inseguras entre el personal del proyecto.

  • Recopilar, consolidar y mantener disponible la información de seguridad del proyecto para requerimientos de la alta gerencia y entes de control.

4. Formación y Cultura HSE

  • Solicitar y ejecutar los entrenamientos y capacitaciones HSE programados en la ODS.

  • Implementar espacios formativos y de refuerzo en temas de HSE dirigidos al personal.

  • Participar activamente en las reuniones del Comité de Seguridad y Salud en el Trabajo y en reuniones periódicas de HSE.

  • Fomentar el autocuidado, la conducta preventiva y una actitud proactiva frente a los riesgos laborales y ambientales.

Autoridad y Rendición de Cuentas

  • Responsabilidad sobre la correcta implementación y seguimiento del Sistema de Gestión HSE del proyecto.

  • Entrega de reportes HSE conforme a la periodicidad definida y a los lineamientos establecidos en revisiones y reuniones gerenciales.

Quién es usted:

About Ethos

Ethos is a leading life insurance technology company on a mission to protect families by democratizing access to life insurance and empowering agents at scale. With its robust three-sided technology platform, Ethos is transforming the life insurance experience for consumers, agents, and carriers alike. Ethos offers instant, accessible products and a seamless online process that requires no medical exams and just a few health questions; it eliminates traditional barriers, making it easier than ever for everyone to protect their families. Ethos is redefining how life insurance is bought, sold, and underwritten.

About the role

Creating a world-class customer experience is critical to Ethos' mission and will continue to determine our growth and success at the intersection of life insurance and technology. We're looking for a leader who can build the CX processes, tools, and voice-of-customer channels we need to move from reactive problem-solving to a proactive customer experience engine: one that consistently identifies where we're falling short and drives improvements forward, end to end. To succeed in this role, you should be passionate about building frictionless operations and comfortable owning ambiguity as we mature this function.

Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Own and execute on a prioritized CX roadmap spanning process, technology, product, and marketing driven improvements - driving cross-functional execution and ensuring priorities translate into delivered outcomes.
  • Own end-to-end synthesis of customer insight across Voice of Customer data, complaints, escalations, and input from other leaders — translating signals from across the business into one clear, prioritized point of view.
  • Own our Voice of Customer platform — validating taxonomy accuracy, evolving reporting, and identifying new data sources that should feed the system.
  • Define and evolve our service channel strategy — determining the right mix of live support, self-service, and automation is used to get customers the help they need.
  • Lead CX operational teams, building the systems, processes, and structure our teams need to scale alongside the business.
  • Partner with cross functional teams on our customer surveying strategy with full platform administration across customer segments.
  • Get personally into the data: pull and validate core reporting directly from Salesforce and other platforms rather than relying on others to package insights before you can act on them.

Qualifications and Skills:

  • 8+ years experience leading customer experience or similar analytics/insight-driven functions with a demonstrated ability to scale a customer experience function.
  • A track record of standing up or running a structured insights-to-roadmap process — turning customer feedback into prioritized, executed work.
  • Demonstrated success influencing roadmap prioritization across product, engineering, or other functional leaders without direct authority over their teams' resources.
  • Genuinely hands-on with data: comfortable pulling and validating core reporting directly from CRM/support platforms.
  • Experience owning or deeply using a Voice of Customer or comparable insight platform as a core, ongoing responsibility.
  • People leadership experience managing a multi-function team with distinct operational workstreams and disciplines.

About the Role:

Motive’s Enablement team plays a critical role in establishing strategic governance for AI tooling and implementing new solutions, ensuring our field teams are equipped with the best tools, workflows, and resources they need to win. We are seeking a results-oriented AI Enablement Specialist to govern, design, and optimize Outreach and other AI-powered sales technology in order to maximize efficiency and effectiveness of our Sales organization.

This is an individual contributor role focused on two connected priorities: Outreach administration and AI tooling strategy. The ideal candidate will establish the operating model for Outreach, build and implement sales sequences directly in Outreach, and partner cross-functionally to scope, launch, and measure AI solutions across tools such as Glean, Full Stack, Google AI Studio, and other emerging technologies. Success in this role is measured by field adoption of central AI solutions, improvements to field efficiency and effectiveness as a result of using these solutions, and influenced Revenue outcomes such as increased pipeline generation.

What You'll Do:

  • Outreach Governance & Strategy: Develop and own the governance model for Outreach content, sequences, and AI-enabled workflows to ensure quality, consistency, and alignment to business goals
  • Sequence Development & Optimization: Build, launch, maintain, and continuously improve sequences based on business priorities and performance data.
  • Experimentation & Performance Analysis: Partner with Marketing to run A/B tests across messaging, personas, and sequencing approaches; analyze performance trends and translate findings into improvements.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Establish and lead an Outreach steering committee, partnering with Sales Leadership, Marketing, Sales Transformation, and other key stakeholders to drive prioritization, performance standards, and sequence adoption.
  • AI Tooling & Enablement: Evaluate which AI agents and workflows can create the most value for the field, and partner with SOPs and AI Operations teams to scope, implement, and measure new solutions.
  • Change Management: Drive field adoption of new Outreach capabilities and AI solutions through clear enablement plans, stakeholder communication, training, and performance measurement.
  • Business Impact Measurement: Define success metrics for Outreach and AI tooling initiatives, monitor adoption and effectiveness, and connect improvements in prospecting effectiveness to pipeline and Revenue outcomes.

What We're Looking For:

  • AI native: experience developing AI governance, strategy, implementing AI tools and building AI solutions for a GTM organization.
  • Sales tool administration experiencewith an emphasis on modern, AI-integrated tools such as Outreach, Glean, Google AI Studio, Fullstack, N8N, and Salesforce.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Computer Science, or a related field
  • 4+ years of experience in sales enablement, revenue operations, or a related role within a high-growth B2B SaaS organization
  • Experience administering Outreach including creating sequences, maintaining sequence libraries, building views and dashboards, and analyzing usage and performance.
  • Fluent in change management methodologies, with demonstrated success driving tool and process adoption across large organizations
  • Strong analytical skills with experience designing experiments, interpreting performance data, and identifying repeatable improvements across personas, messaging, and process
  • Excellent communication and cross-functional influencing skills, with the ability to work effectively with global Sales Leadership, Marketing, Sales Transformation, and Operations stakeholders.
  • Bias for action and comfort operating in a fast-paced environment while managing multiple priorities.

raw.description:
We're so happy you're here! Thank you for checking our job out and we hope to have the chance to meet you in our interview process!

About the role

We're hiring a Senior Retail Operations Specialist to run the daily engine behind Grüns retail fulfillment. You'll ensure every order ships accurately, on time, and in full - protecting revenue, keeping retail partners happy, and catching problems before they become costly. This role connects internal ops, 3PLs, and retail accounts, and owns the proactive inventory and OTIF work that keeps our retail business scaling cleanly. This role reports to our Director of Retail Operations.

This role is part of our remote HQ! We have a fully remote, high-trust work environment - and also come together on a biannual basis for amazing off-sites where we can connect IRL.

In this role, you will:

  • Own day-to-day retail order fulfillment, monitoring and resolving "where's my product" issues before they turn into late or incomplete shipments.
  • Proactively manage base inventory to get ahead of shortages - flagging risk before orders are shorted, not after.
  • Process new orders accurately and on schedule to keep product flowing without disruption.
  • Run proactive inventory reviews for promotions and new item launches to ensure plans execute cleanly.
  • Track OTIF performance, chargebacks, and late trucks, and drive the process improvements that move those numbers.
  • Manage 3PL and logistics partner relationships, resolving escalations and holding partners to SLA.
  • Build and document SOPs across retail ops - receiving, lot/expiry management, promotions, and returns - so the function scales with the business.
  • Identify tools (including AI) and workflow changes that make the role and the broader retail ops function more efficient.

We're looking for someone who:

  • Has 3+ years of experience in retail operations, order fulfillment, or replenishment in a CPG environment, with a genuinely analytical approach to the work.
  • Has direct experience with Walmart and Club channel (Sam's Club, Costco), and ideally distributors like UNFI or KeHE.
  • Understands EDI order management, lot codes, and expiration handling in a retail fulfillment context.
  • Is fluent in Excel or Google Sheets - pivot tables, VLOOKUPs, basic modeling - and comfortable with ERP/WMS systems (Fulfil.io a strong plus).
  • Communicates clearly and confidently with both internal teams and external retail/logistics partners.
  • Is comfortable using AI tools like Claude to move faster and think more clearly, not just check a box.
  • Has a track record of finding and fixing inefficiency, not just maintaining what exists.

Approach to the role:

  • Proactive - flags problems before they become fires, not after.
  • Organized under pressure - manages competing priorities without dropping the important ones.
  • Independent - doesn't need to be managed to stay ahead of the work.
  • Data-driven - makes the call based on facts, not assumptions.
  • Curious and iterative - always looking for a cleaner, faster way to do it.

Compensation & Benefits:

At Grüns, we're committed to providing a competitive total compensation package — grounded in market data that considers our size, stage, industry, and location. For this role, the base salary range is $90,000 - $100,000 plus bonus depending on experience, paired with a comprehensive benefits package designed to support the well-being and growth of our team.

A bit about us...

At Grüns, we believe that foundational nutrition should be simple and convenient for everyone. We're dedicated to bringing comprehensive and real nutrition to you through our gummies, formulated from 60 nutrient-dense and whole-food ingredients. Simply enjoy a grab-and-go snack pack of gummies daily whenever fits best in your schedule and wherever life takes you.

Like you, we were disappointed. There’s an infinite number of “nutrition” companies, all focused on what’s best for them — not what’s best for you. Hundreds of products to sell you on, low-quality ingredients, and small nutrient doses. We’ve seen it all.

So we decided it was time to fix it. No more choking on and popping pills like a pharmacy. No more clean-up and disgust from gross powders. And no more cobbling together handfuls to dozens of supplements. Grüns is comprehensive nutrition, made convenient and delicious.

What we care about...

Be the Best: We hold ourselves, our teams, and our partners to an incredibly high standard - and we raise the bar constantly. "We've never done this before" isn't an excuse here. It's an invitation.

Own It: We act like our name is on the door. That means taking complete ownership of outcomes, collaborating deeply, working through roadblocks - not around them - and never waiting for someone else to solve the problem. Great owners are great partners.

Drive Impact, Urgently: We measure impact, not effort. We work smart and hard, move fast, and use every tool at our disposal - including AI - to focus our energy where it matters most.

Compensation & Perks:

For every role, we aim to have highly competitive compensation and opportunity for impact and career growth.

Everyone at Grüns works hard, but we believe in wellness and balance too. We have super strong benefits coverage -- for you and your family, generous PTO, free Grüns subscriptions, and a few more perks centered around health and well-being that we can't wait to tell you about!

Technical Support Analyst

Remote-United States

Monday to Friday from 9 to 6 EST, 8-5 CST, and 7 to 4 MST

*Some weekend overtime may be required

The Technical Support Analyst (TSA) is a developmental level position within the Support organization primarily responsible for working with CSC Corptax® customers to help with inquiries related to the server and workstation installation and maintenance of Corptax products. The TSA develops a high-level knowledge of the Corptax products and couples that with technical knowledge of Microsoft enterprise systems and related information technologies to validate customer installations and triage customer questions.

The TSA’s primary role is to respond to all customer inquiries regardless of the inbound support channel: online case, phone, email, chat, etc. for questions of a technical nature. This role will occasionally require overtime, including weekends based on customer filing trends/needs. A rotating on-call will be required. Travel is not typically required for this position.

Some of the things you will be doing:

  • Provide technical case support (all channels) for all Corptax customers and other internal Corptax teams using the then-current tools available to the Support organization.
  • Understand customer needs and provide personalized support to assigned customers or other customers as requested based on areas of specialization/expertise and customer need.
  • Respond to and provide appropriate solutions to intermediate level customer inquiries while maintaining moderate case closure rates.
  • Collaborate with team members in a fast-paced environment.
  • Work under clearly defined guidelines, with moderate supervision, making sound decisions based on previous experience and confirming your conclusions with more senior level team members prior to execution.
  • Document all customer issues in the Corptax case tracking system and assign or document appropriate solutions to the customer issue.
  • Review knowledge base solutions within professional expertise to ensure overall quality of our resources and digital support capabilities.
  • Develop proficiency in all Corptax products from a technical perspective.
  • Perform release testing, as required, of customer scenarios both prior to and after a new Corptax product release. Testing is a shared responsibility, including triage of new product releases and identifying potential required software enhancements.
  • Assist on various projects as assigned.
  • Learn new technology and experiment with potential internal efficiency solutions.
  • Demonstrate consistent exemplary standards of ethical conduct.
  • Promote a culture of cooperation, collaboration, and connection within the support team, as well as globally with other CSC business units.

What technical skills, experience, and qualifications do you need?

  • Position requires 3-4 years of relevant software support experience, ideally in Microsoft systems such as Windows Server, IIS, SQL Server, and SharePoint.
  • Exposure to automation, packaging, and monitoring tools such as Ansible, PowerAutomate, SailPoint, Elastic, SSCM, Microsoft Intune, and API’s.
  • Bachelor’s degree in a technology field is preferred or relevant experience.
  • High standards of customer service and support, honesty, and integrity.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft products.
  • Ability to quickly learn Corptax technologies.
  • Ability to accurately and completely document case information into the Corptax case tracking software.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills.
  • Strong, positive attitude and work ethic desired.
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team, possessing moderate conflict resolution and negotiation skills to provide positive customer experiences.
  • Strong communication skills – both written and verbal.
  • Strong interpersonal skills.
  • Self-motivated with a drive for continuous improvement.

*This role is not eligible for employment visa sponsorship (e.g., H‑1B, TN, E‑3) now or in the future.
